title: Mo Laamu Sujji Hade Maandeeji Mum
intro: Jaɓɓungal kaawningal ina fadi ɓeen cuusɓe safrude ndee sirlu. E nder kelle Wahyuuji, ina woodi laamɗo gooto mo kawral mum e annabi ina wayla sifaa leñol fof. Ndee ɗoo limre laamiima gila e jappeere laamu woɗnde, ardiinde aadaaji ɓooyɗi, haa nde sahaa keeriiɗo goonga diine wayli laamɗo e laamu haa abada. Mbele aɗa udditana ooɗoo ruuhu teskinɗo mo daartol mum ɓuuɓnata ko haawnii e ko luggiɗi?
clues: Mi laamiima leñol ɓuuɓngol e nder ndiyam woɗɗuɗam, lollungol e gese amen e galle laamorɗo toowɗo.
Laamu am ina toowi, kono laamu mawngu arii luulndaade woodgol men e mbaydi men tigi.
Birniwol tokosol ina joginoo mesaas keewɗo faayiida, kaawisaaji garooji ɗii mbonni miijooji am fof e doole.
Nde nji’mi jappeere wayliima yeeso gite am, mi anndi hay maayɗo gooto waawaa jogaade baawɗe hono ɗee.
Mi hollitii e peeñcu wonde miɗo ɗooftoo Joomiraawo gooto kammu e leydi, miɗo woppi kala ko njiɗnoo-mi yiɗde.
Enen leñol ngol, en mbayliima dewal naange ɓooyngal, en njaɓii goonga wayluɗo huunde fof.

outcome.answer: En njaɓɓoriima Alla, en njaɓɓorii iimanaagal goongawal

arabic: فَقَالَ إِنِّىٓ أَحْبَبْتُ حُبَّ ٱلْخَيْرِ عَن ذِكْرِ رَبِّى حَتَّىٰ تَوَارَتْ بِٱلْحِجَابِ
verse: And he said, "Indeed, I gave preference to the love of good [things] over the remembrance of my Lord until it [i.e., the sun] disappeared into the curtain [of darkness]." (38:32)
